text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While we're at the gym, Mejiro Ryan looks at me and groans weakly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… My muscles will never be their best at this rate…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I haven't been able to lift as much as usual during my bench presses.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: I've had no luck adding weight to my chest and leg presses either.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Guh… What the heck is going on with my body?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Amidst all the racing she's been doing lately, she hasn't noticed her growing fatigue. Maybe I should rethink her schedule…
